transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Lee. Thank you for fitting me in, I really appreciate it. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... my family kind of wanted me to come. They keep acting like I'm, well, imagining things. 

I don't want to sound foolish, and I really hope you don't judge me for saying this, but... I know my wife's relative has been coming into our house to get at me. I mean, I work with my hands for a living, I know exactly where I leave my things. My tools don't just move themselves, you know? And it's other things, too, like my fishing plans getting spoiled every single weekend. It's just not an accident. 

I wouldn't even bring it up if I wasn't absolutely sure, I promise. I don't like to cause a fuss. But after all these months... I can see plain as day he's been trying to take over my place and push me out. Does that... does that make sense to you, Doc? Am I explaining that okay?
Besides these beliefs about your wife's relative, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people don't seem to hear, or seen things that others don't see?

Oh, no, Doctor. No, definitely not. I... I've never had anything like that happen. 

I know sometimes people who hear voices are, well, you know, really unwell... and I promise you, I'm not like that. My mind is perfectly sound. I just see what's right in front of me, like my tools being moved around my workbench. I don't hear anyone talking when they aren't there, or see things that aren't real. 

I'd tell you if I did, I really would. I don't want you to think I'm holding anything back, I just want to be completely honest with you so we can get this sorted out. Is... is that what you were asking? I hope I'm giving you the right answers.
Can you tell me about any alcohol or drug use, including how much and how often, over the past several months?

Oh, no, Dr. Lee. I don't do any of that. I... I really hope you don't think I'm the sort of person who gets mixed up in drugs or anything, because I'm definitely not. 

And I don't drink, either. I mean, doing assembly work all day, I have to keep my hands steady and my head clear. I haven't had a drop of alcohol in... well, I can't even remember. Certainly not in the past several months. I just stay away from it all, especially with everything going on at the house. I need to stay sharp. 

I just want to make sure I'm doing everything right, you know, taking care of myself the best I can. Does... does that answer your question okay? I can explain more if you need me to.
Have you had any recent head injuries, seizures, or been diagnosed with any medical or neurological conditions, such as thyroid problems, infections, or neurological illnesses?

Oh, no, sir. No, nothing like that at all. Um... I've always been in pretty good shape, honestly. No head injuries, no seizures... I mean, working on the floor, safety is a huge priority, so I'm always very careful. 

I haven't been diagnosed with any thyroid problems or infections or anything like that, either. I just go to my regular check-ups and everything has always been completely normal. I really try to take good care of my health, you know? Eat right, get enough sleep. 

Is... is that the kind of information you're looking for? I hope I'm being helpful. I just want to make sure I'm answering everything exactly how you need me to.
How long have you been noticing these beliefs about your wife's relative moving your things and interfering with your plans—has this been going on for months, or longer?

Well, um... I know you called them beliefs, Doctor, but I hope it's okay if I just say they're things I've noticed? I really don't want to sound like I'm just making things up, because I promise I'm not. 

But, um... to answer your question, it's been going on for about nine months now. It started right when my wife's relative moved into our home. I really tried to be accommodating, you know? I wanted to be a good host and not cause any friction in the family. I always try to keep the peace. But that's exactly when my tools started getting shifted around and my projects started getting interfered with. 

I actually kept quiet about it for a while because I didn't want to be a bother or seem difficult... I hope it's alright that I waited this long to talk to someone about it. Is... is nine months the kind of timeline you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need.
Over these past nine months, how have things been with your work, your energy, and your overall mood day to day?

Well, um... my mood and energy have been pretty steady, honestly. I don't want you to think I'm falling apart or anything like that, because I'm really not. 

I still get up every single day, go down to the plant, and do my assembly work just like always. I make sure the bills are paid on time, and I'm taking good care of myself... keeping my routine, you know? I've always prided myself on being reliable, and I haven't let any of this stop me from being a good provider. 

The trouble really isn't with me or my mood... it's just all centered on what's happening at the house with him and my things. As long as I'm away from there, at work, everything is perfectly fine. 

I hope that makes sense? I just want to reassure you that I'm still functioning well and doing everything I'm supposed to do. Is that the kind of detail you needed about my day-to-day?

Aside from your concerns about your wife's relative, have you noticed any changes in how you think, speak, or express your feelings—like trouble organizing your thoughts, or pulling away from friends and family?

Oh, no, Doctor, nothing like that. I really try to stay organized, both in my head and in my life. I haven't had any trouble putting my thoughts together or speaking clearly... at least, I hope I'm speaking clearly to you right now? I always try to make sure I'm making sense.

And I haven't pulled away from anyone, no. I still talk to my friends at the plant, and I still spend time with my wife, of course. I really try to be a good husband and a good friend. I just... I don't want anyone to think I'm acting strange or withdrawing, because I'm really trying my best to keep everything as normal and pleasant as possible. 

I haven't noticed any changes like that at all. Is... is it okay that I don't have anything like that to report? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
Aside from your wife's relative, have you had similar suspicions or felt that other people—coworkers, friends, or strangers—might be trying to harm you or interfere with your life?

Oh, no, no. Not at all, Doctor. I really want to be clear about that. It's... it's just him. 

I get along fine with the guys at the plant, and our neighbors are perfectly nice people. I've never had any trouble with anyone else trying to mess with my things or, you know, interfere with my life. I really try to be the kind of person who gets along with everybody, and I think most people see that and treat me well in return. 

I don't go around looking for problems or being suspicious of people, I promise. I just... I just know what I've seen happening in my own house since he moved in. But outside of that, everything is completely fine. I hope that shows that I'm not just, um, paranoid or anything? I just want to make sure you know I'm generally a very trusting person.
Does your wife believe the same things you do about her relative moving your tools and interfering with your plans, or does she see it differently?

Well, um... to be honest, Doctor, I try really hard not to bring it up too much with her. I don't want to cause any friction, you know? She loves her family, and I always want to be a supportive husband. 

I think... well, I'm not entirely sure exactly what she believes about it. Maybe she just hasn't noticed the tools being moved, or maybe she sees it a bit differently than I do. I haven't really pushed the issue because I just want to keep the peace in the house. I mostly just keep it to myself so she doesn't get stressed out. 

I hope that's the right way to handle it? I just really don't want to upset her or make you think we're arguing all the time, because we're not. We have a good marriage. Is it okay that I just kind of... avoid the subject when she's around to keep things pleasant?
